verdict.rationale: Aleph documents dashboards built to share metrics across the business, and dashboards or reports saved for the team to revisit (aleph-docs-19, aleph-docs-7). It also documents team and user permissions and fine-grained access controls (aleph-docs-18, aleph-docs-25), and markets board-ready variance analysis (aleph-docs-3). However, none of the evidence shows how dashboards or reports are actually shared with board members or other external viewers, or that permissions can be scoped to an individual dashboard or report. Missing for 10: documented board/external viewer sharing (links, viewer seats or exports), explicit per-dashboard/per-report access scoping, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
